meals.name: Sheet Pan Lemon Chicken & Veggies
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces. Chop zucchini, peppers, and onion into bite-sized chunks. Halve the baby potatoes.
Toss everything with olive oil, minced garlic, juice of 1 lemon, salt & pepper.
Spread on a large sheet pan in a single layer.
Roast 22-25 minutes until chicken is cooked through and veggies are tender.
Squeeze remaining lemon over top before serving.

meals.name: Honey Garlic Salmon
instructions: Cook quinoa according to package directions.
Mix honey, soy sauce, and minced garlic for the glaze.
Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet with foil.
Place salmon fillets on one side, asparagus on the other. Drizzle asparagus with olive oil.
Brush salmon generously with honey garlic glaze.
Bake 12-15 minutes until salmon flakes easily.
Serve over quinoa with asparagus on the side.

meals.name: Lean Beef Taco Bowls
instructions: Cook rice according to package. When done, stir in chopped cilantro and lime juice.
Brown ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Drain any excess fat.
Add taco seasoning and 1/4 cup water. Simmer 3-4 minutes.
In another pan, sauté sliced peppers until tender. Add drained black beans to warm through.
Build bowls: rice on bottom, beef, peppers & beans on top.
Top with your favorites: salsa, cheese, sour cream, avocado.

meals.name: Garlic Herb Pork Tenderloin
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Pierce sweet potatoes with a fork and bake 45-50 min (start these first!).
Rub tenderloin with olive oil, minced garlic, chopped rosemary, salt & pepper.
Sear tenderloin in an oven-safe skillet 2-3 min per side until browned.
Transfer skillet to oven. Roast 15-20 min until internal temp reaches 145°F.
Toss broccoli with olive oil, salt & pepper. Roast on a sheet pan alongside pork for 15-18 min.
Let pork rest 5 minutes before slicing. Serve with broccoli and split sweet potatoes.

meals.name: Greek Chicken & Veggie Bowls
instructions: Cook brown rice according to package directions.
Season chicken with olive oil, oregano, garlic powder, salt & pepper. Grill or pan-sear 6-7 min per side until cooked through.
Dice cucumber, tomatoes, and red onion. Toss together with a drizzle of olive oil and red wine vinegar.
Make tzatziki: mix Greek yogurt with minced garlic, chopped dill, lemon juice, salt.
Slice chicken. Build bowls with rice, chicken, veggie salad, crumbled feta, and tzatziki drizzle.

meals.name: Crispy Baked Tilapia
instructions: Cook wild rice according to package (usually 45 min — start first!).
Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment.
Mix panko, grated parmesan, and a pinch of salt.
Pat tilapia dry. Brush with olive oil, then press panko mixture onto top of each fillet.
Bake 12-15 minutes until fish flakes and topping is golden.
Sauté green beans in olive oil with minced garlic 5-7 min until tender-crisp.
Serve fish over rice with green beans. Squeeze lemon over everything.
